description:
scaffoldLoopSection emits a doubly-commented line (`# meta_loop = "auto"  # accepted: ...`); uncommenting it by removing the leading `#` yields a pinned `meta_loop = "auto"` (not the code default `off`). This is a reasonable opt-in design, but a one-word note that uncommenting pins the shown value would make operator intent explicit.
